description: 101 connects ChatGPT to your workspace for financial analysis and project operations. Analyze company financial health using balances, income, expenses, transactions, bills, contractor settlements, and cost categories. Review and manage settlements and linked transfers. Search projects, tasks, comments, team members, estimates, price lists, and Wiki pages. Create and edit financial events, transfers, estimates, tasks, comments, and Wiki content.

defaultPrompt: Assess my company’s current financial health. Highlight cash gaps, risky projects, and the three actions I should take first.
Show my tasks for this week, grouped by project. Highlight overdue and high-priority work.
Who should we pay this week, and in what order? Review contractor balances and prepare a payment plan.
